description: This file contains transformation logic and exception handling for Hosted VLLM's audio transcription component, specifically related to the hosted VLLM rerank process. It defines a custom exception class, a configuration class extending an OpenAI transcription config, and methods to construct API URLs and process audio transcription requests.
